family: Figurative magical effects: matter, swarms, apparitions, blades and traps

selection_basis.excluded: current productions, accepted animation resources, canonical duplicates already produced; character animations BDETHREA/MSOLG1; native shadows/black-only masks; runtime palette-dependent projectiles; consumers not established
selection_basis.scope: largest retained visible fixed-palette cohort with known owners; visually related subgroups, independent native alpha/playback contracts

proposed_processing.spatial: SeedVR7B x4 RGB; source silhouette, anchors, fine insect/blade details retained; contour treatment per subgroup
proposed_processing.temporal: Apollo30 per native cycle, remove duplicate poses then redistribute over unchanged native duration; preserve constant cycles; TRAPGR static
proposed_processing.render: straight-alpha normal consumers; premultiplied Blended consumers. SPIPLAAI/SPIPLARI share pixels but have mixed consumers.
proposed_processing.rate: VVC field 15FPS; PRO cadence requires confirmation, no cadence measurement inferred
